Russia launched a large-scale combined attack on Ukraine on the night of 14-15 June using drones and various types of air-, sea- and ground-launched missiles. Ukrainian air defences have destroyed or jammed 632 out of 681 aerial assets.

Source: Ukraine's Air Force

Details: The city of Kyiv was the main target. Missile strikes were also reported in Dnipro and Kharkiv.

In total, Ukrainian air surveillance troops detected 681 aerial assets, specifically 70 missiles and 611 drones of various types:

Aircraft, anti-aircraft missile units, electronic warfare assets, unmanned systems units and mobile fire groups from Ukraine's defence forces have been involved in repelling the attack.

Early reports indicated that as of 08:00, Ukrainian air defence forces had destroyed or jammed 632 aerial assets, namely 50 missiles and 582 drones:

Early reports indicated that as of 08:00, hits by 20 ballistic missiles and 27 UAVs had been recorded at 42 locations and the fall of downed aerial assets (debris) at 12 locations.

Quote: "The attack is ongoing, as several enemy drones are still in Ukrainian airspace. Please observe safety measures!"
